channel.title: Brio
channel.description: Updates for Brio, the macOS menu-bar developer toolbox.

item.title: 0.9.0-beta.12
item.description:
What changed since v0.9.0-beta.11

  • Fit the symbol detail to the panel and default to Bounce
  • Note the toast test's wall-clock race in the open items
  • Record the symbol detail row's parked items
  • Keep the symbol pickers honest and the typing rule testable
  • Describe the symbol detail row in the feature map
  • Open a symbol's detail under its line in the Symbols tab
  • Select, move between and filter symbols by release and keyword
  • Describe a symbol's modes, effects and code line for the detail row
  • Correct the plan's release count to 25
  • Carry each symbol's first release, layers and keywords
  • Plan the symbol detail row in four tasks
  • Spec the symbol detail that opens under its row
  • Regenerate the symbol catalog for SF Symbols 27
  • Record the parked list in docs/OPEN.md and update Current status

item.title: 0.9.0-beta.11
item.description:
What changed since v0.9.0-beta.10

  • Give the total's rule one home and an oracle
  • Close the scoped re-review's blockers on the fix wave
  • Close the whole-branch gate's five must-fix findings
  • Re-read every category after a delete, and stop claiming runtimes take their simulators
  • Reclaim four more developer-disk categories in the Data tab
  • Add Current status section to CLAUDE.md and drop duplicated Liquid Glass note
